caption: Relying on a single AI response can miss risk and nuance when evaluating ideas. Use this five-prompt framework to diagnose, compare, stress-test, plan, and verify. What idea are you evaluating first this week? #AI #productivity #decisionmaking #startups

slides.title: AI alone harms decisions
slides.body: Relying on AI alone biases judgment. Five prompts to evaluate ideas more robustly.

slides.title: 1. Diagnose criteria
slides.body: Task: For [IDEA], list 5 decision criteria with 1-sentence justification each. Output: 1–5 lines, criterion — justification.

slides.title: 2. Compare options
slides.body: Task: Compare [IDEA] vs [ALTERNATIVE], rate on each criterion 1–5, include brief pros/cons. Output: a table-like list.

slides.title: 3. Stress-test risks
slides.body: Task: Identify top 3 failure modes and 2 mitigations each for [IDEA]. Output: bullet list.

slides.title: 4. Plan execution
slides.body: Task: Draft a 90-day plan for implementing [IDEA], with milestones and metrics. Output: timeline bullets.

slides.title: 5. Verify with feedback
slides.body: Task: Prepare 3 questions to run past a reviewer; incorporate feedback into plan. Output: reviewer questions and revised plan.

slides.title: Takeaway
slides.body: Takeaway: A structured evaluation beats a single AI answer. Save this framework for clear, defendable decisions.
